what: Real request/response pairs of the official IBS/CBS calculator (Calculadora de Tributos da Reforma Tributaria do Consumo), POST /calculadora/regime-geral, replayed by oracle.test.ts. Never edited by hand: re-record by calling the endpoint with each *.request.json and saving the body as the matching *.response.json.
notes: Only 2026 can be recorded: the calculator answers 404 for the rates of 2027 and later.
Alcohol and sweetened drinks are absent: the calculator demands Imposto Seletivo data for them, which the engine does not take.
NCM codes are the ones the calculator links to each cClassTrib (it refuses an unlinked NCM with 422).
